svg.title: Preload torque vs stroke – drawing 44-04
svg.text: Preload torque test – torque vs stroke (dynamic preload torque)
Screw turns at 100 min⁻¹, nut held by a force arm on a load cell, no seals, standard grease. Ends (50 mm) are ignored.
max 0.334 · min 0.260 · largest deviation 14.3 % of Tp – inside ± 40 %: OK
torque T = F · r e.g. F = 2.92 N, r = 100 mm gives 0.292 N·m
Tolerance band ± % of Tp (example JIS B 1192-3 / ISO 3408-3 style)
